rationale: AT&L careers page invites civil drafters and civil designers to send a CV and cover letter to hr@atl.net.au and says the firm is growing in Melbourne.

Its Melbourne work includes Amaroo Business Park in Craigieburn, where AT&L designed roads, stormwater drainage, earthworks and retaining walls, which matches Marc's Advanced Diploma road, earthworks and stormwater coursework in Civil 3D and AutoCAD; Melbourne CBD office is reachable from Melton.
No numbered vacancy or stated level, so this is a labelled speculative enquiry at graduate level.
caution: No advertised vacancy; AT&L may only want experienced drafters. Software experience is academic.
gaps: No commercial civil drafting production experience
No Australian site or office work experience yet
apply_instructions: Email hr@atl.net.au with CV and cover letter (published on the careers page).
